method: Each listed render of the board (cad/render_previews.py at 7560034f9) opened and inspected whole and in quadrants at full resolution. Supplements, does not replace, ERC/DRC/parity, the JLC fab pass and the independent pin audit.
not_reviewed_this_pass: gerber-outline.png (outline checked on every other layer and by DRC/edge_clearance.py)
schematic pages (review basis: native ERC and parity)

observations.gerber-ground.png: In1.Cu is one GND plane. Voids only at the intended op-amp input relief: the U5 block (rectangle, top left), U6 (strip) and the U7/TIA L-shape. BNC centre pins, THT headers and signal vias cleared; four mounting holes.
observations.gerber-inner-routing.png: In2.Cu: the analog buses in the upper half (SOURCE_BUF / TIA_OUT down the relay column, HPOT/LPOT legs), unpoured there by design; GND pour over the lower half and the LDO/switcher corner. The D4 LED line runs down the left edge to the digital block; the edge-clearance check puts the nearest track 0.90 mm from the V-cut edge.
observations.gerber-bottom-copper.png: B.Cu: DUT_HI along the BNC band then down to K4 as documented; the RP2040 relay-drive bundle and the rail-monitor taps; the 2.0 mm 5 V trunk along the south edge from J1 to the switcher; GND pour over the lower half. No B.Cu components.
observations.pcb-front.png: Silk: BNC labels HCUR/HPOT/LPOT/LCUR at J3/J7/J8/J9 and the DISCHARGED DUT ONLY warning; TP labels (5V, 3V3, GND, +12, -12, RAW+, RAW-, VRLY, RST, K1-K4); LED labels 5V/3V3/+12/-12/HB/FLT; TEMPER LCR REV F. Switcher island (U13, L1/L2, D2/D3) bottom right, the codec top left: far corners.
observations.gerber-top-copper.png: F.Cu matches pcb-front.png: four identical codec input legs (D11-D14 clamps, C69-C77, R62-R65); relay column K1-K3 with R40-R42/R43-R45 stubs; U16/U3/D1 at J1; compact switcher loop around U13.
observations.gerber-top-mask.png: Openings for all SMT lands, exposed pads, THT, the 14 test pads and three fiducials; vias covered.
observations.gerber-bottom-mask.png: Bottom openings only for THT pads (BNCs, J4-J6), the USB shell slots and pegs, and the mounting holes: vias tented.
observations.gerber-top-paste.png: Exposed pads windowpaned (U1 2x2, U14 2x2, U13 3x3, U11/U12 2x3); no paste on THT, test pads or fiducials; SOD-323 apertures small (0.6 x 0.45 mm lands, the KiCad SOD-323 land) but present on all five diodes.
observations.gerber-top-silk.png: References legible at review zoom; no silk seen on lands (the fab pass checks 0.15 mm); polarity marks at D1, D11-D14 and the IC pin-1 corners.
observations.assembly-top.png: Every part outline has its reference, including the packed supply/LDO parts not on silk; J4-J6 (DNP) outlines present; FID1-FID3 and H1-H4 shown.
